text: Create local folder downloaded files. Download selected files. download_files() works one reference time, code groups selected resource IDs reference. lot files, take time. Check failed downloads continuing.
code: topic_slug <- topic |>   str_to_lower() |>   str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "-") |>   str_replace_all("(^-|-$)", "")  download_dir <- path("servcat-files", topic_slug) dir_create(download_dir) download_plan <- selected_files |>   group_by(referenceId) |>   summarise(     resource_ids = list(resourceId),     .groups = "drop"   )  downloads <- download_plan |>   mutate(     result = map2(       referenceId,       resource_ids,       \(reference_id, resource_ids) {         download_files(           reference_id = reference_id,           resource_ids = resource_ids,           path = download_dir,           secure = secure,           overwrite = FALSE         )       }     )   ) |>   pull(result) |>   list_rbind()  downloads downloads |>   count(success)  downloads |>   filter(!success | is.na(success)) |>   select(any_of(c("referenceId", "resourceId", "fileName", "error")))

what: Optional: create a RAG store with ragnar
title: Use ServCat Files in a RAG Store
text: downloaded files now ready use source documents. example shows general pattern ragnar: create store, convert files Markdown, split chunks, insert chunks, build index. section can call embedding API, make sure model-provider API key configured running . Test retrieval connecting store chat model.
code: library(ragnar)  store_path <- path(download_dir, "servcat-rag.duckdb")  store <- ragnar_store_create(   location = store_path,   embed = \(x) ragnar::embed_azure_openai(x,                                            model = "text-embedding-3-small",                                            endpoint = "https://api-dev.ai.doi.net/",                                           api_version = "2024-02-15-preview"),   overwrite = TRUE,   name = "servcat_files",   title = "ServCat files" )  successful_downloads <- manifest |>   filter(success, !is.na(localPath), file_exists(localPath)) |>   mutate(     origin = paste0(       "servcat://reference/", referenceId,       "/resource/", resourceId,       " | ", fileName     )   )  for (i in seq_len(nrow(successful_downloads))) {   message("ingesting: ", successful_downloads$fileName[[i]])   chunks <- successful_downloads$localPath[[i]] |>     read_as_markdown(origin = successful_downloads$origin[[i]]) |>     markdown_chunk()    ragnar_store_insert(store, chunks) }  ragnar_store_build_index(store) store <- ragnar_store_connect(   location = store_path,   read_only = TRUE )  ragnar_retrieve(   store = store,   text = "What information is available about Kodiak mountain goat monitoring?",   top_k = 5 )

title: R Interface for the FWS ServCat API
text: Use search_references() run ServCat Advanced Search one search criteria. Search criteria sent body POST request, paging sorting options sent query parameters. Page metadata ServCat response stored "page_detail" attribute. can combine multiple criteria request body. NULL values criteria omitted request body serialized, useful optional fields logicOperator, fieldName, searchText. Common criteria include quick search terms, visibility, legacy status, version filters, regions, units, text fields, dates, reference types, reference groups, bounding boxes, subject categories, digital resources, physical copies, saved collections, people.
code: results <- search_references(   criteria = list(     quickSearch = "Kodiak, goats"   ),   top = 25,   page = 1 )  results attr(results, "page_detail") reports <- search_references(   criteria = list(     visibility = "public",     textFields = list(       list(         order = 1,         logicOperator = NULL,         fieldName = "Title",         searchText = "mountain goat"       )     ),     digitalResources = list(       list(         order = 2,         logicOperator = "AND",         type = "DigitalFile",         fieldName = NULL,         searchText = NULL       )     )   ),   top = 100,   page = 1,   orderby = "dateOfIssue",   sort = "DESC" )  reports

title: Search ServCat references — search_references
text: Executes ServCat Advanced Search using POST request. Search criteria posted request body, paging sorting parameters sent URI query parameters.

title: Search ServCat references — search_references
code: search_references(   criteria,   top = 25,   page = 1,   orderby = NULL,   sort = NULL,   composite = FALSE,   all_pages = FALSE,   secure = FALSE,   api_key = NULL )

title: Search ServCat references — search_references
text: criteria named list Advanced Search criteria. Supported top-level fields include: quickSearch character string search using ServCat Quick Search. supplied, Quick Search primary source results, filters applied results. visibility Optional visibility filter. Use "public" return public records, "internal" return internal records, NULL omit visibility filter. Non-secure services can return public records. legacy Optional legacy-status filter. Use "excludelegacy" return non-legacy records, "onlylegacy" return legacy records, NULL omit legacy filter. version Optional version filter. Use "" include versions versioned records, NULL omit version filter. regions list Region filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, unitCode. units list Unit filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, unitCode, linked, approved. textFields list text-field filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, fieldName, searchText. Valid fieldName values include "Abstract", "Notes", "TableOfContent", "ContactName", "Publisher", "Keyword", "MiscellaneousCode", "Title", "DisplayCitation". dates list date filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, fieldName, filter, startDate, endDate. Valid fieldName values include "DateOfIssue", "ContentBeginDate", "ContentEndDate", "LastEdited", "DateCreated". Valid filter values include "BeforeDate", "AfterDate", "BetweenDates", "Exactly", "NotEquals", "NotBetween". referenceTypes list Reference Type filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, referenceType. referenceGroups list Reference Type Group filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, group. rectangles One bounding boxes represented OGC Well-Known Text polygon strings, example "POLYGON((-121.8 45.7,-116.4 45.7,-116.4 42.0,-121.86 42.0,-121.8 45.7))". subjectCategories list Subject Category filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, subjectCategory, subjectCategory numeric Subject Category identifier. digitalResources list Files Links filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, type, fieldName, searchText. Valid type values include "DigitalFile", "ExternalLink", "WebService". physicalCopies list Physical Copy filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, unitCode, searchText. collections list Saved Collection filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, collection, collection numeric Saved Collection identifier. people list Owner Creator filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, fieldName, searchText. Valid fieldName values include "Creator" "Owner". searchText value staff UPN partner user code. criteria sections accept multiple entries, logicOperator can used combine exclude criteria. Common values include "", "", "". Group operators "ANDGROUP", "ORGROUP", "NOTGROUP" may used supported ServCat API. top Number entries per page. Defaults 25. Use larger integer, 1000, reduce paging, avoid values large request may time . page One-based page index return. Defaults 1. all_pages = TRUE, first page requested. orderby Optional name single field sort results. sort Optional sort direction. Must "ASC" "DESC" supplied. composite Logical. TRUE, use composite Advanced Search endpoint, returns additional nested detail linked resources associated units. Defaults FALSE. all_pages Logical. TRUE, request pages sequentially starting page combine results one tibble. Defaults FALSE. secure Logical. Use secure API? api_key Optional secure API key. omitted, package API-key helper used secure requests.

title: Search ServCat references — search_references
text: tibble Advanced Search result items. Page metadata response stored "page_detail" attribute. all_pages = TRUE, "page_detail" list containing page metadata requested page. composite = TRUE, returned tibble may include list-columns linkedResources units.

title: Search ServCat references — search_references
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Quick Search using the Advanced Search endpoint results <- search_references(   criteria = list(     quickSearch = "Kodiak, goats"   ) )  results  # View paging metadata attr(results, "page_detail")  # Request more results per page results <- search_references(   criteria = list(     quickSearch = "Kodiak, goats"   ),   top = 100 )  # Retrieve all result pages all_results <- search_references(   criteria = list(     quickSearch = "Kodiak, goats"   ),   top = 100,   all_pages = TRUE )  # Return composite results with linked resources and units composite_results <- search_references(   criteria = list(     quickSearch = "Kodiak, goats"   ),   composite = TRUE )  # Search public records and sort by issue date results <- search_references(   criteria = list(     quickSearch = "Kodiak, goats",     visibility = "public"   ),   top = 100,   page = 1,   orderby = "dateOfIssue",   sort = "DESC" )  # Search by reference type. NULL fields are omitted from the request body. reports <- search_references(   criteria = list(     referenceTypes = list(       list(         order = 1,         logicOperator = NULL,         referenceType = "Unpublished Report"       )     )   ) )  # Search within title text title_results <- search_references(   criteria = list(     textFields = list(       list(         order = 1,         logicOperator = NULL,         fieldName = "Title",         searchText = "mountain goat"       )     )   ) )  # Search by date range date_results <- search_references(   criteria = list(     dates = list(       list(         order = 1,         logicOperator = NULL,         fieldName = "DateOfIssue",         filter = "BetweenDates",         startDate = "2010-01-01",         endDate = "2020-12-31"       )     )   ) )  # Search for records with public digital files file_results <- search_references(   criteria = list(     digitalResources = list(       list(         order = 1,         logicOperator = NULL,         type = "DigitalFile",         fieldName = NULL,         searchText = NULL       )     )   ) ) } # }

what: servcat: Access the ServCat REST API — servcat-package
title: servcat: Access the ServCat REST API — servcat-package
text: Provides R functions querying U.S. Fish Wildlife Service ServCat REST API. package includes helpers searching references, retrieving reference records reference-associated metadata, downloading digital files, retrieving saved-collection contents, accessing ServCat fixed-list lookup values.

title: servcat: Access the ServCat REST API — servcat-package
text: package uses public ServCat API default. Functions support secured services include secure api_key arguments. secure = TRUE api_key omitted, package attempts read API key SERVCAT_API_KEY environment variable. metadata functions return tibbles. Detailed reference profile requests return named lists ServCat API response contains nested metadata. Nested API fields, linked resources associated units composite search results, may returned list-columns. Search functions return one page results default. search_references() can retrieve pages all_pages = TRUE, stores ServCat paging metadata "page_detail" attribute returned tibble. File downloads performed download_files(), returns tibble reporting local file path, download status, per-file error message.

title: servcat: Access the ServCat REST API — servcat-package
text: get_references() retrieves detailed ServCat reference profiles reference ID. get_reference_summaries() retrieves summary metadata one ServCat reference IDs. search_references() executes ServCat Advanced Search requests, including optional composite results -page retrieval. get_collection_references() retrieves references saved collection. download_files() downloads one ServCat digital files reference. service_version() returns ServCat service version.

title: servcat: Access the ServCat REST API — servcat-package
text: get_owners() retrieves owners associated reference. get_keywords() retrieves keywords associated reference. get_links() retrieves external links associated reference. get_files() retrieves digital file metadata associated reference. get_bibliography() retrieves bibliography metadata reference. get_lifecycle() retrieves lifecycle metadata reference. get_units() retrieves units associated reference. get_bboxes() retrieves geographic bounding boxes associated reference. get_subjects() retrieves subject categories associated reference. get_taxa() retrieves taxa associated reference.
